description: This PHP source file defines the class 'LoggerAppenderRollingFile', an extension of 'LoggerAppenderFile' used for logging. It implements a rolling file appender that manages log file sizes, creates backups, and handles log rotation behavior.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderRollingFile
classes.description: A log4php appender that writes logs to a file and manages log rotation by size, with support for backup files.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderRollingFile
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the appender with a name.

methods.name: getExpandedFileName
methods.description: Returns the expanded filename used for logging.

methods.name: getMaxBackupIndex
methods.description: Returns the maximum backup file index.

methods.name: getMaximumFileSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum file size allowed before rollover.

methods.name: rollOver
methods.description: Performs log file rollover, renaming old backup files and managing the backup limit.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the log file and updates its expanded path.

methods.name: setMaxBackupIndex
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of backup files to retain.

methods.name: setMaximumFileSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the log file before rollover.

methods.name: setMaxFileSize
methods.description: Defines the maximum file size with support for size suffixes (KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: append
methods.description: Logs an event, and triggers rollover if the file size exceeds the limit.
